tagline: 理光便携相机，1986 年发布
description: 理光于1986年推出的便携相机。配备Ricoh Lens 35mm f/2.8, 5 elements in 5 groups。快门速度programmed, 2 ~ 1/500 sec.。感光度ISO 25 ~ 1600 (in 1/3 steps), DX-code system or Manual。Single-point active autofocusing system。

specs.镜头: Ricoh Lens 35mm f/2.8, 5 elements in 5 groups
specs.取景器: Albada-type, with bright-frame, 0.44X, field of view 84%
specs.感光度: ISO 25 ~ 1600 (in 1/3 steps), DX-code system or Manual
specs.英文简介: The FF-300D is an autofocus point-and-shoot camera for 35mm film, introduced by Japanese manufacturer Ricoh in 1986.
